{"claims":[{"claim_text":"George W. Bush ran for President on a promise of lower taxes.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Everyone who pays income taxes should see their income taxes reduced.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The President offered a plan to lower all tax rates.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Republicans in Congress strongly supported the President's plan.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"In 2001, President Bush signed historic tax relief into law.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"43 million families with children are receiving an average tax cut of over $2,000 this year.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"A new 10 percent income tax bracket was created.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Individual income tax rates for all Americans who pay income taxes were lowered.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The child tax credit was doubled to $1,000.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"The marriage penalty was reduced for 33 million married couples.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[6]},{"claim_text":"Education IRAs were expanded, pre-paid tuition plans were made tax-free, and a deduction for higher education expenses was created.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[7]},{"claim_text":"The death tax was phased-out.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[8]},{"claim_text":"IRAs and 401(k)s were simplified and expanded.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[9]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
